object.attr: as implemented: two calls can't interleave their writes. Reworded from the mechanism to the property (review Q13); the test sends a second call before the first is answered, also in the wheel smoke job (CF-M14). A long call holds up the calls after it (MELLON-VER-SRS-86).
object.description: When two tool calls overlap, the MCP server shall give each call the result and file changes that running the calls one after the other gives.
